issues.where: tiles B–E and H–I, especially the moon and right-hand cloud belts
issues.what: The moon's surface markings dissolve into directional smears, and much of the globe goes soft while adjacent stars stay sharp.
issues.fix: Reduce the directional blur and resolve the moon and cloud textures at the close-up scale rather than sharpening the smeared render.

issues.where: tiles K, L and P, orange cloud belt and pale ridges above the Great Red Spot
issues.what: The clouds read as embossed or glossy solid material: tight bright outlines and dark grooves exaggerate the relief, and some of the brightest ridges break into colored, blocky fringes.
issues.fix: Reduce the hard relief and specular response, use broader scattering across cloud layers, and supersample the high-contrast filaments.

issues.where: tile O, directly to the lower right of the moon
issues.what: The nearly uniform black oval appears to start at the moon's silhouette, with an edge that stays comparatively hard until the tip. It looks more like a drop shadow attached to the moon than a shadow projected onto Jupiter's curved cloud deck.
issues.fix: Project the shadow onto the globe from the moon's actual scene position and use an area light to give the umbra and penumbra a consistent falloff.

issues.what: A broad cream-colored bloom bleaches the cloud detail just inside the limb and leaves a diffuse halo outside it.
issues.fix: Dial back bloom and separate the atmospheric scattering from the surface exposure so both the rim and nearby cloud detail remain legible.

issues.where: lower third and lower right (crops S, T, V, W, D, I, E)
issues.what: the foreground cloud deck goes to soft, smeared mush at native size: streaky brush-like swirls with no structure and a few bright clumps of cloud dropped in. It reads as painted and airbrushed, not as close-up cloud tops
issues.fix: add real detail to the near clouds (billows, shadowed cells, fine wisps) and lift the shadows a little so the detail shows, or crop or fade the muddy lower band

issues.where: storm vortex, center left (crops A, B, F, K)
issues.what: the storm's spiral is made of repeated, evenly spaced strokes that look like oil paint or swirled plastic. The bands look like brushwork, not turbulent cloud
issues.fix: break up the regular spiral strokes with chaotic eddies and varied scale, and reduce the sharpening and the glossy highlights

issues.where: lower middle and right (crops E, U, V)
issues.what: the patches of glowing cyan-blue speckle look like a glitter or noise overlay pasted onto the dark clouds. They do not match the lighting and look like an artifact
issues.fix: remove the blue glow patches, or replace them with lightning that is lit properly and lights the cloud around it

issues.where: upper left limb and horizon (crops J, B, G)
issues.what: the haze near the horizon is blown out to a flat cream wash with no detail, and the far clouds turn into a blurry smear
issues.fix: pull the highlights back near the horizon and keep some layered detail in the haze at the limb

issues.where: limb on the right (crops C, H, L, Q, R)
issues.what: the blue atmosphere band is a smooth, uniform line of even width with a fairly hard outer edge, like a gradient laid over the image
issues.fix: vary the thickness of the limb glow and soften its outer edge into space

issues.where: moon at right center (crops C, P, Q)
issues.what: the moon is a small, soft, plastic-looking ball with smeared, Jupiter-like streaks and no surface features. Its crisp edge and strong light look pasted onto the planet's dark terminator
issues.fix: give the moon a sharp surface map of its own at native size (a volcanic or cratered surface), and match its lighting, edge softness and scale to the scene

issues.where: Great Red Spot and band detail (crops A, P, K)
issues.what: the Red Spot is oversaturated, with painterly concentric strokes, and the band turbulence is soft and smudged at native size, like an airbrushed illustration
issues.fix: lower the saturation of the spot, add the fine filament and eddy detail of real Jupiter imagery, and sharpen the turbulence in the bands

issues.what: the bright halo at the limb is a thick, evenly bright glow, so the edge of the disk looks burned and slightly doubled
issues.fix: make the limb glow thinner and fainter, and let it fade out gradually

issues.where: below the night-side limb (crops E, V, U)
issues.what: a faint blue haze patch sits behind the dark limb and ends against it along a hard curve, so the planet looks cut out over a backdrop
issues.fix: remove the haze or blend it naturally, and soften the edge of the dark limb against it
